Angefragt: alle Bücher, die jemand angef: Requested: every book someone asked for, with the running time from the shop (declined ones don't count). A series counts as one request. Heard: listening time from Audiobookshelf (every minute) and Plex (only titles played to the end) – shown once an account is linked under Settings → Accounts. Waiting time: how long it typically takes from the request to the finished book.
Ihre Sachbücher erscheinen in „Für dich“: Their non-fiction appears in “For you”. Already included: everyone whose books were reviewed in the arts pages (Perlentaucher – FAZ, SZ, Zeit, Deutschlandfunk …) or who appears in the reviews under “From the critics”, plus a fixed list of about 400 authors of fact-based non-fiction since 2010 (e.g. Yuval Noah Harari, Stefanie Stahl, Mai Thi Nguyen-Kim, Harald Lesch, Christopher Clark, Giulia Enders). One name per line or separated by commas. This checks reputation, not content.
Ob ein Sachbuch inhaltlich stimmt, kann: Whether a non-fiction book is right, no software can check. So “For you” only shows non-fiction by established authors – whose books were reviewed in the arts pages or who are on Hörwerk's list of serious non-fiction authors. In “By genre” all non-fiction appears when you pick a non-fiction genre – with a note.
